acceptance_criteria: User can add items to the cart
User can enter shipping address
User can select a payment method
User sees order summary before confirming
User sees order confirmation after placing order

goal: Test the product search and filtering functionality
acceptance_criteria: User can search for products by keyword
Search results display matching products
User can filter results by category
User can sort results by price
Empty search results show a helpful message
User can log in with valid email and password
Invalid credentials show an error message
User can request a password reset
User is redirected to the dashboard after login
Session persists across page refreshes
Product name and description are displayed
Product images are visible and can be cycled
Price is shown correctly
User can select product variants such as size or color
Related products are shown at the bottom of the page
User can add a product to the cart
User can update the quantity of a cart item
User can remove an item from the cart
Cart total updates when quantity changes
Cart persists when the user navigates away and returns

goal: Test payment processing error conditions and validation
acceptance_criteria: System shows error when payment fails due to insufficient funds
Invalid card number shows inline validation message
Expired card shows specific expiry error message
User can retry payment after a failed transaction
Successful payment clears the cart and redirects to confirmation

goal: Test the full coupon application and checkout multi-step flow
acceptance_criteria: User adds item to cart, views cart summary, applies a valid coupon code, and proceeds to checkout
Applying an invalid coupon code shows a descriptive error message
Discount amount is correctly reflected in the order total after coupon is applied
Removing an applied coupon restores the original order total
Checkout cannot be completed when coupon field is left with an unsubmitted invalid code

goal: Test email format validation and unauthorized access prevention
acceptance_criteria: Invalid email format shows a validation message on the registration form
Empty email field prevents form submission and shows required field error
Unauthorized users are denied access to protected account pages
Valid email with correct password grants access to the user dashboard
Account lockout occurs after repeated failed login attempts with wrong credentials
